page.title: Fixed expenses
page.subtitle: Bills and subscriptions that repeat every month

banner.title: Mark what each expense is
banner.body: Tap Subscription or Bill on an expense. Subscriptions get a cancel button, so you'll see what you can cancel.

cancel.title: Did you cancel {{name}}?
cancel.bodyWithLink: We opened the provider's cancellation page. Once you've cancelled there, confirm here and we'll stop this expense from today. Past payments stay.
cancel.bodyWithoutLink: There's no cancellation link saved. Cancel with the provider, then confirm here and we'll stop this expense from today. Past payments stay.

empty.title: No fixed expenses yet
empty.body: Add a recurring expense, like a subscription or a bill, to see what you pay every month.

errors.cancelFailed: Couldn't stop this expense. Try again.
errors.updateFailed: Couldn't save the changes. Try again.
